mccitybuilder.help.title: How roads and walls work
mccitybuilder.tip.start: Click to start a segment, then click again to drop it. Each click starts the next one from there.
mccitybuilder.tip.snap: The end snaps to whole pieces; the label at the cursor says what it snapped to. Hold Shift for any length.
mccitybuilder.tip.corner: To turn, aim the next segment sideways and click: a corner piece goes in and the last segment grows to stay whole.
mccitybuilder.tip.close: To close a shape, point right at an open end: it connects with an L (R: the other way). Right-click or Esc finishes.
mccitybuilder.tip.edit: Edit mode (X) moves ends, joints and segments, and sets joint types. The ? button here explains it all.

mccitybuilder.ponder.draw.1: Click where the segment should start.
mccitybuilder.ponder.draw.2: Click again to drop it: its end snaps to a length the pieces fill exactly (the label says how many).
mccitybuilder.ponder.draw.3: Hold Shift while you draw for any length: cells no piece covers show as an amber box.
mccitybuilder.ponder.draw.4: Each click starts the next segment from the last end. At a turn a corner piece goes in, and the last segment grows a little so its pieces stay whole.
mccitybuilder.ponder.joints.1: Where segments meet, a joint piece goes in: a corner for an L.
mccitybuilder.ponder.joints.2: Three segments meeting make a T.
mccitybuilder.ponder.joints.4: C changes the joint type for new joints, or the joint selected in edit mode: here a tower, if the style has one.
mccitybuilder.ponder.connect.1: The chain's live end is where the next segment starts. Its first segment's start is still an open end.
mccitybuilder.ponder.connect.2: Moving off toward the open end, the preview follows the cursor in a straight line as usual.
mccitybuilder.ponder.connect.3: Over the open end it snaps: an L of two segments (cyan) closes the shape. R picks the other corner when both fit.
mccitybuilder.ponder.connect.4: One click drops both segments and ends the chain. Backspace takes both back.
mccitybuilder.ponder.height.1: H cycles the height mode. Follow: the pieces follow the ground.
mccitybuilder.ponder.height.2: Flat: the segment at its highest ground. Air under raised pieces shows amber: nothing fills it.
mccitybuilder.ponder.height.3: Smooth: raised so no step is over 1 block.
mccitybuilder.ponder.height.4: Flat chain: one level for the whole chain.
mccitybuilder.ponder.height.5: PgUp / PgDn raise or lower the segment.
mccitybuilder.ponder.gaps.1: Between two joints whole pieces may not fit: the amber box shows the cells no piece covers.
mccitybuilder.ponder.gaps.2: Fill gaps (F) adds a straight cut to exactly the uncovered cells, cut where its edges carry on the pattern of the pieces beside it. Nothing overlaps.
mccitybuilder.ponder.gaps.3: Red outline: a piece is outside the colony or runs into a building or another segment. Build skips that segment.
mccitybuilder.ponder.gaps.4: You can also drag an end in edit mode, or try another joint type: the joint menu shows what each leaves uncovered.
mccitybuilder.ponder.edit.1: X turns on edit mode: amber nodes at the ends and joints, a handle in each segment's middle.
mccitybuilder.ponder.edit.2: Drag an end or joint to move it, a middle handle to move the segment. Moves snap so walls keep whole pieces; Shift moves freely.
mccitybuilder.ponder.edit.3: Click a node for its joint type. Alt-click or double-click selects a whole wall; Tab turns Whole wall mode on or off.
mccitybuilder.ponder.building.1: Build sends every green segment. Creative and survival both need City Builder on the server.
mccitybuilder.ponder.building.2: In creative it appears at once; in survival builders get a work order per piece. Built segments show grey.
mccitybuilder.ponder.building.3: Built segments are locked: no dragging and no right-click delete.
mccitybuilder.ponder.building.4: Del or Remove still deletes one; its blocks come down too (at once in creative, by a builder in survival).
mccitybuilder.ponder.roads.1: Roads are drawn the same way: segments, joints, connect, edit mode and Fill gaps work alike.
mccitybuilder.ponder.roads.2: Gates (G) are for walls only; on roads G does nothing.
mccitybuilder.ponder.roads.3: R flips a segment to face the other side out, on roads as on walls (white: the selected segment).
